purpose: Add an owner-only issue-comment bridge that dispatches the existing canonical exact-SHA web-only production release for a validated historical main ancestor, avoiding full-stack API/database mutation for public web UX releases.
requiredBehavior: only issue 3048 comments created by the repository owner can enter the command job
command grammar requires exactly /production web exact followed by one lowercase 40-character SHA
target commit must exist and be an ancestor of current origin/main
the bridge only dispatches production-web-exact-sha.yml with deploy and DEPLOY-EXACT-SHA confirmation
the bridge performs no direct production transport or runtime mutation
the canonical web release remains responsible for image verification health live acceptance evidence and rollback
forbiddenCapabilities: API deployment or API runtime mutation
TAI model runtime workflow or infrastructure changes
direct SSH SCP or Docker production commands in the bridge
